subject: Post-call: BlueOak cost sketch & next steps
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Porter <alex.porter@blueoak.ai>, Priya Singh <priya@blueoak.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call: BlueOak cost sketch & next steps

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and the open items I promised to capture: 

- High-level ask: short pilot (3 months) to validate MLR scoring and customer-facing summaries, then expand to more use-cases.
- Expected steady-state usage (your estimate): 5M–12M tokens/month initially; spike/burst patterns around product launches (~2x baseline for short windows).
- Target unit economics you mentioned on the call: target budget roughly $6k–$10k/month for initial pilot (you asked for a sketch at a $/1M-token target between $250–$350).

Attached is a quick cost model (blueoak_pilot_cost_model_v1.xlsx) and a one-page snapshot of our hosted pricing cadence. The sheet contains three scenarios: conservative (5M), base (10M), and aggressive (20M) tokens/month along with line-item estimates for inference token cost, request concurrency, and optional reserved capacity.

Two asks / next steps:
1) Can you confirm which scenario looks closest to your internal plan (conservative / base / aggressive)? A single-sentence reply is fine.
2) If the base (10M) looks right, I’ll prepare a formal estimate with a simple reserved vs. hosted comparison and a recommended SLA/fallback plan.

Notes on assumptions in the attached: model = open-35B-ish; streams are conversational (average response length ~75 tokens); we assume prefix caching on product-side for repeated prompts. If any of those assumptions are off, call it out and I’ll update.

Thanks —
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[d] +1 415-555-0199 | dylan.brooks@redwood.ai

Attachments: [blueoak_pilot_cost_model_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 48 KB)], [redwood_pricing_snapshot.pdf (PDF, 120 KB)]
From: Alex Porter <alex.porter@blueoak.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya@blueoak.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 16:05:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: BlueOak cost sketch & next steps

Dylan —

Thanks for the recap and the files. Quick answers inline: 

- Scenario: base (10M tokens/month) is the closest to what we’d like to plan for initially. We could be at ~6–8M for month 1, ramping to ~10M by month 2–3.
- Budget: leadership is comfortable with $6k–$9k/month for the pilot; they’d like to see the $/1M token math that hits the low end of that range.
- SLA/burst: we need burst support (short spikes up to 2.5x) and an SLO for p95 latency under 250ms where possible for interactive features.

Two quick questions: 
1) In your v1 sheet you show a blended $/1M tokens number. Can you provide a line-item that isolates model per-token inference vs. platform/network/ops overhead? We want to compare directly to our internal cost targets.
2) For the reserved-capacity path, what would a minimum commitment look like (monthly $ or committed GPU hours)?

If you can turn v1 into a base-10M scenario with those two lines split and a clear monthly invoice sketch, we can share with finance for an internal green-light.

—Alex
Alex Porter
Head of Product, BlueOak Analytics
alex.porter@blueoak.ai | +1 617-555-0123
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Porter <alex.porter@blueoak.ai>, Priya Singh <priya@blueoak.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: BlueOak cost sketch & next steps

Alex —

Thanks, this is helpful. I updated the model into a focused 10M-token worksheet and split the costs the way you asked. See attached v2. Highlights below: 

Summary (10M tokens / month baseline):
- Model inference (per-token): $2.40 per 1k tokens -> $2400 per 1M tokens (this is illustrative for the chosen model family and q8 quantization path).
- Platform & ops overhead (routing, KV cache storage, telemetry): ~$80 per 1M tokens.
- Blend (hosted API): ~$2480 per 1M tokens.

Pilot invoice sketch (monthly, base = 10M):
- Token usage (10 x $2480 per 1M): $24,800
- Burst buffer (credit-based, infrequent usage): ~$1,200 est.
- Support/observability add-on (recommended for pilot): $1,000 flat
- Estimated monthly total (hosted): ~$27,000

Reserved capacity alternative (committed):
- Typical entry: 1 reserved GPU pod (NVIDIA H100 equivalent) + managed control plane = $9,000/month committed + lower per-token marginal (~$1,600 per 1M tokens)
- If you commit to reserved, the 10M token spend would look like: $9,000 + (10 x $1,600) = $25,000/month (plus recommended $500 support retainer)

Notes / options:
- To hit your $6k–$9k/month leadership target we’d need to adjust scope (token reduction via more aggressive prompt engineering / shorter responses) or explore a deeply discounted pilot commitment (we can propose a stepped discount tied to usage milestones).
- The p95 latency SLO for interactive features is achievable on hosted, but bursts >2x will depend on region capacity and routing; reserved capacity gives the most predictable tail latency.

I attached the updated worksheet (blueoak_pilot_cost_model_v2.xlsx) with a line-by-line invoice sketch and scenario toggles. Also included a plain-text one-pager you can forward to finance.

Next step suggestions:
- If BlueOak wants to evaluate reserved economics, I’ll schedule a 30-min call with our Dedicated specialist (Sean Gallagher, CC’d) to size pods and commitment options.
- Alternatively, we can draft a short pilot quote with a stepped discount that targets $9k/month if certain token-volume milestones are hit.

Which path would you prefer for the formal estimate?

Best,
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: [blueoak_pilot_cost_model_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet, 64 KB)]

Subject: Re: Post-call: BlueOak cost sketch & next steps

Dylan / Sean —

Looping Sean to help with reserved-sizing and to expedite a concise commit-based quote if BlueOak prefers that path. Alex / Priya — thanks for the clarity on budget targets.

Action items I’ll take on: 
- Sean, can you confirm minimum reserved configuration and the short-term ramp terms (we usually offer a trial window for the first 30 days for new dedicated customers).
- Dylan, please prepare a 1-page quote: two columns (Hosted vs Reserved) with monthly totals and a short note on how to reach a sub-$10k scenario (scope or discount). I’ll attach a sample PO template we’ve used for pilots once we have the totals.

Alex / Priya — availability check: would Friday 11/06 at 11am PT work for a short alignment call to run through the 1-pager and next steps to engage finance?

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
